newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT - England bowl out NZ Selection for 138.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - England bowl out NZ Selection for 138.

text.p: PALMERSTON NORTH, Jan 13 - England dismissed the New Zealand Selection for 138 just before tea on the opening day of their four-day first-class cricket match on Monday, NZPA reported.
England captain Mike Atherton sent the combined side in to bat and his bowlers backed his judgement on a lively pitch.
Opener Craig Spearman made 41, Justin Vaughan 24 and Matt Horne 22 in an otherwise disappointing New Zealand Selection display.
The pick of the England bowlers were allrounder Craig White, who finished with four for 15 from 9.4 overs, and fast-medium pair Chris Silverwood and Dominic Cork, who picked up two wickets apiece.

England's fielding also impressed. Atherton took an excellent reflex catch at gully to dismiss test batsman Adam Parore for nought, Andrew Caddick clutched an athletic one-handed catch at mid off while Silverwood showed a fine arm to run out Mark Haslam with a direct throw from the third man boundary.
The match is one of two first-class fixtures for England in their buildup to the first test against New Zealand, starting in Auckland on January 24.
